snippet.title: Cross Blitz | Release date trailer
snippet.description:
Cross Blitz is setting sail into its full 1.0 release on November 24th
Play now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1619520/Cross_Blitz/


- 5 playable heroes with unique storylines
- 500+ collectible and customizable cards
- 60+ hours of story-rich gameplay in Fables Mode
- Roguelite mode Tusk Tales with randomized maps & 12 bosses
- Introducing a brand-new playable character: Mereena 🧝‍♀️


To keep the latest updates on Cross Blitz on hand, follow @TheArcadeCrew, @takoboystudios on Twitter and join Tako Boy Studios’ Discord : https://discord.gg/takoboystudios
